name: Maddie B
quote: I passed my test after just 2 weeks of lessons — something I never thought would be possible. Kais is incredibly patient, supportive, and explains everything in a way that just clicks. He made me feel genuinely confident and comfortable behind the wheel.

name: Zoë Anderson
quote: I've had three very good driving instructors in my time learning — and I have to say that Kais has been the best of them all. He told me he wouldn't just teach me to pass the test, but how to become a confident, capable driver. He delivered on exactly that. I passed first time at Cheetham Hill.
passedDate: Passed first time · Cheetham Hill Test Centre
